_comment: Jev MCP servers — copy to ~/.jev/mcp.json and edit. ONLY servers listed here ever run: this file is the trust boundary. Jev never downloads, installs, or launches an MCP server on its own.

_fields.command/args/env/cwd: stdio only: what to launch. Bare command names resolve via PATH, then the Python venv's bin dir.
_fields.confirm: 'outward' (default: writes/sends/deletes ask first, reads run silently), 'all' (every call asks), 'none' (never asks — dangerous, only for servers you fully trust)
_fields.enabled: false keeps the entry but never connects.
_fields.transport: 'stdio' (launch a local command) or 'sse' (connect to a URL)

servers._comment_fetch: Fetch web pages as markdown (pip install mcp-server-fetch). Read-only; runs silently.
servers._comment_filesystem: Local file tools (npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem <dir>). Restrict args to directories Jev may touch. Writes ask for confirmation.
servers._comment_remote: Example of a remote server over SSE. Only use servers you trust — an SSE server sees every argument you send it.
servers._comment_sqlite: Local SQLite database tools (pip install mcp-server-sqlite). Reads run silently; write_query/create_table ask for confirmation.
